items.text: Nico Collins hamstring in Wed practice (Houston Chronicle); missed 5 games on hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI tomorrow. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15, Wayne 8.
items.why: Dominant route share; soft-tissue history raises multi-week concern even if not serious.
items.implication: If out, target volume shifts heavily to Hutchinson/Boutte; Collins rostered as WR1 risk.
items.opportunity: 37 routes / high share indicates alpha role when healthy.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full practice after ankle issue signals high likelihood of return.
items.implication: Boosts NE backfield; monitor for lead role vs committee.
items.opportunity: Full go increases snap/carry share chance.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring DNP early in week raises Week 2 availability concern.
items.implication: Monitor; if out, DEN RB committee shifts (JK Dobbins etc.).

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery to quicken recovery; out four games. ETR beneficiary: Rashod Bateman (and Chris Moore).
items.why: Wrist surgery; IR for accelerated recovery, minimum 4 games.
items.implication: BAL WR snaps open; Bateman primary add/upgrade.
items.opportunity: Lane was camp standout; absence boosts remaining WRs.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week on FF Happy Hour amid SF WR depth injuries (Stribling multi-week).
items.why: Stribling expected multi-week absence opens snaps/routes; Shanahan scheme fits Deebo gadgets + targets.
items.implication: Priority add in leagues where available; WR3/flex upside with volume bump.
items.opportunity: Week 1: solid targets/routes + rush work; more available with Stribling out.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) DNP Wednesday practice after big hit in Week 1; day-to-day, status vs Raiders uncertain. ETR flags Tre’ Harris as primary waiver beneficiary.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; worked sideline with trainer but no practice participation.
items.implication: If out, Chargers WR depth thin (Lambert-Smith IR); Johnston/Harris upside.
items.opportunity: McConkey was Herbert's lead target (5-82-1) before exit.

items.text: A.J. Brown (high ankle) on IR, out at least 4 games. ETR Week 2 waiver beneficiaries: Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas. Deebo also rises via related SF depth (Stribling).
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; IR minimum 4 weeks, no surgery.
items.implication: Patriots WR room opens; stash Brown, stream Doubs/Douglas immediately.
items.opportunity: Douglas led routes Week 1; Doubs signed big to be outside option.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance return Week 2 or 3. Same left knee as prior PCL sprain + bone bruise last season. Scary. Coach: working tail off; day-to-day, DNP Wed.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team optimistic short absence but knee history warrants caution.
items.implication: Monitor practice; TE1 upside if active, Mayer holds otherwise. ETR ROS relevant.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share). 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. 'He fucks.'
items.why: As expected for workhorse role post-trade; elite opportunity share + efficiency.
items.implication: Lock-in RB1 every week; elite volume floor/ceiling in Chiefs offense.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early opps + high routes/targets = three-down feature back.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday. Got mental reps and expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness but player expects to play; mental reps only.
items.implication: CIN offense likely full go; low panic unless Friday designation worsens.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1. He simply played a horrific game (finish far below xFP).
items.why: xFP (targets/location/depth model) elite; actual production horrific due to drops/inefficiency.
items.implication: Strong buy-low; underlying opportunity supports WR2/3 rebound.
items.opportunity: High xFP from quality targets indicates role/volume intact.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury. No plans to place on IR.
items.why: Glute injury; ruled out but short-term (no IR).
items.implication: Drew Lock likely starts; SEA offense streaming/QB2 impact; ETR flags Lock streamer.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night). Needs serious volume; only 2 targets/7% share notable but routes elite (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks, behind only Worthy 30).
items.why: High routes confirm role; low aDOT + low targets = volume-dependent for fantasy payoff.
items.implication: Hold/strong start if target share rises; ETR ROS discussion includes him prominently.
items.opportunity: 29 routes on 33 dropbacks signals every-down involvement.
items.conflict: Low targets vs high routes may regress positively or stay inefficient.
